input.decision: This is the agency's own check-out works job on a vacant flat. On 6 April the landlord got the first estimate (event 006) and asked for a comparison quote from another contractor (event 009). Because the agency raised this job, I don't need landlord approval to get a quote, and the landlord asked for one. So I have assigned a second panel provider through the platform's provider step, for a comparison quote only. The scope is the same six items, and no work is to start without our approval. I have emailed the landlord a short reply saying what happens next, and put the case on hold: Waiting for Provider, "Holding for second quote", chase on 11/04/2025. In order, what happens next: (1) the second contractor sends their quote; (2) I email the landlord both figures side by side with VAT made clear, and hold Waiting for Landlord; (3) once the landlord approves one quote, I give that contractor the go-ahead and hold Waiting for Provider. The first estimate stays open with the landlord. Nothing is approved or instructed yet. Who pays for tenant damage through the deposit will be decided later, on the evidence in the check-out report.
